description.content: API Calls to retrieve statistics about the Wired Ports at the Site level

Count switch and gateway port statistics for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by port, neighbor, PoE, STP, traffic, and time attributes. Use [Count Org Switch/Gateway Ports](/#operations/countOrgSwOrGwPorts) to count switch and gateway port statistics across the organization.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Search switch and gateway port statistics for a site.
Returns ports that match the search criteria, including current or most recent port status and statistics within the hour.

Traffic information (Tx/Rx) is reported as cumulative counters since the last device reboot. Use [Search Org Switch/Gateway Ports](/#operations/searchOrgSwOrGwPorts) to search switch and gateway port statistics across the organization.
